premises.text: Businesses need a comprehensive telecommunications platform that integrates various services.
premises.evidence_span: there hasn't been a single platform where you can actually get all of your telecommunications services from the same system until today

premises.text: Current mobile devices used for business lack essential features like extension dialing and call recording.
premises.evidence_span: it doesn't do extension dialing. It doesn't do call recording.

premises.text: Integrating mobile devices with a communication switch enhances business functionality.
premises.evidence_span: we have been able to integrate mobile with our Switch directly

premises.text: Seamless call transfers and presence tracking are possible through the integrated system.
premises.evidence_span: you can do seamless call transfers, presence lights on the mobile

premises.text: Real-time transcription is a valuable feature for training and archiving.
premises.evidence_span: speech-to-text transcription on the fly. This is great for trainings.

premises.text: Private telecom networks are essential for security-sensitive organizations.
premises.evidence_span: the government is one thing that likes to have a private telecom network

premises.text: International calls can be made significantly cheaper through the integrated system.
premises.evidence_span: international calls or IP are significantly cheaper

premises.text: APIs allow for customization and integration with other software systems.
premises.evidence_span: all of this technology, even the activation of the cell phone, is being done via APIs that are exposed to you

value.text: Businesses can achieve better communication and functionality through an integrated telecommunications system.
